title: Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator
description:
Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator reports to the Training Site Infrastructure Manager and the FIFA Training Site Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ requires advanced infrastructure and technical services to deliver a seamless tournament experience. The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator will work alongside the Training Site Infrastructure Manager on the successful delivery and readiness of all FWWC2023 training site infrastructure and overlay requirements throughout the country. The manager will also project manage all Host Country and Local Entity deliverables.

This role will also work with external stakeholders, such as Training Site Authorities, to be part of the Training Site infrastructure team in planning, delivering, and preparing all FWWC2027 training sites in Brazil. The successful candidate will work with the Training Site Authorities and local entity colleagues to ensure the delivery and readiness of the renovations, beautification, upgrade and completion of existing works at training sites. In addition, they will oversee infrastructure and overlay delivery, installation, and dismantling, as well as supply and storage of field of play and training equipment at training sites.

As a member of the Technical Services & Overlay team, you will also work closely with other workstreams, such as Pitch Management, Venue Design, and Dressing and Signage, to ensure the FWWC2027 is delivered to the highest possible standard and, where possible, leaves a lasting legacy.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA's exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist the Training Site Infrastructure Manage in the design and delivery of infrastructure required at training sites for the FWWC2027.
  • Ensure specifications, space and area allocations are developed in compliance with the FIFA training site requirements and fit for purpose.
  • Monitoring the training site renovations, beautifications and upgrade program and overlay deliverables and timelines to ensure all training sites are ready for the participating Teams when they arrive.
  • Assist in the procurement, delivery and installation/storage of field of play and training equipment for all training sites.
  • Participating in regular review meetings to discuss the delivery and readiness of training sites with all external and internal stakeholders.
  • Assist in the handover and hand back of all training sites for the tournament period.
  • Working with Facility Management Services and Cleaning & Waste providers to ensure the training sites are maintained at the appropriate standards during the Teams’ time in the host country.
  • Ensure all equipment and overlay requested are provided and set up by the requirements and location.

Your Profile

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in a coordination role in overlay, infrastructure, or technical services in events.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Strong and dynamic interpersonal, leadership and communication skills with an ability to maintain focus in a high-pressure and fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in supplier coordination.
  • Relationships with local suppliers and contractors and well-established networks within the industry would be advantageous.
  • Reliable and committed to meeting quality standards and deadlines, good planning and anticipation, focus on efficient implementation, and follow up after completion.
  • Knowledge of overlay delivery, temporary infrastructure, and technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license is a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Finance Analyst (Brazil)
description:
Objective of the role

The Finance Analyst will play a key role in supporting the analysis and structuring of financing transactions, assessing market rates, debt and equity alternatives, and applying advanced financial models. The position is expected to contribute to the design of financial strategies aligned with corporate goals, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and high-quality decision-making.

Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain financial models for corporate and project transactions, including the use of financing Model A.
  • Review and validate financial models prepared by external advisors, ensuring consistency with company assumptions and industry best practices.
  • Analyse and validate technical and financial assumptions together with specialised teams, assessing their impact on results.
  • Conduct market rate analysis and evaluate its effect on projects and financing structures.
  • Assess financing options (debt and equity), supporting the structuring and negotiation of alternatives.
  • Support capital raising processes (debt and equity), including the preparation of financial materials, participation in due diligence, and interaction with investors and financial institutions.
  • Prepare and contribute to capital presentations for investors, the board of directors, and other key stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with internal departments (technical, legal, commercial) and external advisors to ensure timely and accurate information flow.
  • Conduct market and risk analysis to support investment and financing decisions.
  • Prepare financial reports, presentations, and executive summaries for management, investors, and other relevant audiences.

Qualifications

  • University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial analysis, ideally in investment banking, M&A, and/or debt financing.
  • Advanced skills in financial modelling and analytical tools.
  • Fluency in English and Portugues (mandatory).
  • Spanish is a plus
  • Proactive, versatile, and curious profile with strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Commitment to sustainability and diversity values.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to take on new tasks according to business needs.

Oferecemos autonomia, objetivos claros e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador,onde os profissionais têm a oportunidade de interagir com diferentestecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias etrabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) de qualquer lugar domundo. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independentemente de sua condição,deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ououtras. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e cheio deoportunidades.

Você se identificou? Então, #VemSerMeta!

title: Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Full relocation to Saudi Arabia – permanent full-time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview: We are seeking a Plant Corrosion Engineer to join the Riyas Engineering Division (RNGLFD) which is part of the Riyas NGL Fractionation Dept (RNGLFD).

RNGLFD is responsible for two trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train will include fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. The common facilities will include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage and utilities including, but not limited to, steam and condensate recovery systems, utility water, plant, instrument air and nitrogen systems, machinery cooling water, drainage and flare systems. Some of the systems (e.g., steam headers, flare headers, product storage) have been pre-invested for the future train.

Your primary role will be to implement, support and continually improve RNGLFP inspection corrosion management programs and provide consolatory advice in materials, ensuring cost effective material selection and corrosion mitigation strategies, which will ensure mechanical integrity of the materials, applied on all plant assets including equipment and piping through their life cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement corrosion management program and on-stream monitoring and Conduct risk-based inspection based on API-580 methodology.
  • Review and approve recommended solutions for coating failures and cathodic protection and participate in HAZOP review sessions and ensure that all issues are addressed.
  • Manage water treatment program and recommend solutions to overcome challenges and review design packages and validate materials selection based on current code and standards.
  • Validate corrosion controls corrosion controls, corrosion (CCD), corrosion loops and corrosion damage mechanisms frequently.
  • Assess FEED composition changes and approve recommended solution to assure assets integrity.
  • Develop scope and description of technology items, and lead field implementation.
  • Develop and transfer knowledge about use of coating, Cathodic protection (CP), corrosion inhibitors and other corrosion controls and best practices.
  • Extract data and draw conclusions from Corrosion Monitoring Technologies, and troubleshoot corrosion problems and address root causes.
  • Perform the regular review and update on the plants Integrity Operating Windows (IOW) and Corrosion loops drawings shall be updated by adding emerging damage mechanisms or removing damage mechanisms because of plant upgrades.
  • Adjust and modify inspection practices and programs shall be reflected based on such modifications and perform special studies in corrosion control. Evaluates data as to scope, impact and long-range cost effectiveness on existing and new projects.
  • Review operations and monitoring activities to identify needed system modifications or procedural changes associated with corrosion control with conduct corrosion mitigation and integrity review to optimize the inspection and corrosion programs and maintain assets integrity.

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in mechanical engineer.
  • 15 years' experience processing in Oil/Gas Industry.
  • Demonstrate experience in material science and metrology, different NDT technology and their applications and knowledge in engineering aspect of welding.
  • Strong Knowledge of international standards and codes NACE, ASME, API and ASTM especially inspection and corrosion standards such as API-571, API-580, API-570 and API-510.
  • Valid NACE Specialist Certification or NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist or combination of NACE Corrosion Technologist, API-571 and NACE CP level II.

title: Onboarding Manager (Remote)
description:
Overview

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration. MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every team member, enabling you to work from anywhere in the world and set your own hours.

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team, the Onboarding Manager is a critical first impression of our organization and our ability to support publishing partners in reaching their goals. You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You will orchestrate a "White Glove" onboarding experience that reduces time-to-value and supports long-term retention. You will also contribute to improving systems and processes to continuously enhance our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  • Project Management & Implementation
  • Lead the publisher lifecycle from Sales endorsement to Live status; manage the publisher’s first 30-90 days
  • Technical Coordination with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration
  • Feature Activation: ensure applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue (KPI: Uptake %)
  • Kick-off & Strategy: conduct kickoff calls to understand publisher goals and align implementation plans
  • Ambassadorship: act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products; provide comprehensive walkthroughs for comfort and proficiency
  • Responsive Support: serve as the primary contact during installation with technical and empathetic guidance
  • Performance Reviews: conduct 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews and identify early optimization wins
  • Seamless Transition: manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager

External Engagement

  • Meet new partners and lead high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their goals
  • Project Command: manage the entire implementation lifecycle and coordinate with technical teams for a revenue-ready setup
  • Performance Ownership: conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day performance reviews to prove value
  • Seamless Handoff: orchestrate a smooth transition to account management to sustain momentum

Role Fit & Organization

This is a cornerstone role pivotal to the company’s success. You will deliver a white-glove experience, acting as a bridge between Sales promises and long-term operational success, ensuring every new client has clarity and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

Must Haves:

  • Experience: 1+ years in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, Google Analytics; WordPress and debugging ad calls a plus
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation; ability to spot trends quickly
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written skills; capable of managing expectations and communicating clearly
  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AdSense, Google Analytics, GAM and knowledge of Google policies; WordPress ads implementation and debugging
  • Understanding coding and strong tech background
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are a bonus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary: Adjusted to cost of living and experience
  • Remote Work: Work from anywhere
  • Flexible Hours: Autonomy to set your schedule
  • Team Retreats: In-person company get-togethers
  • Career Growth and Learning Opportunities

If you think you’re a good fit for our Ad Optimization team, please apply and share specific reasons what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots, so feel free to show personality. Interviews are conducted virtually.

title: Assistente Contábil I | Negócios
description:
Descrição da vaga
Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.
Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.
A área de Contabilidade é responsável pelo registro, controle e análise das operações financeiras da companhia, garantindo conformidade com normas contábeis e suporte às áreas de negócio. Os principais desafios incluem lidar com alto volume de informações, prazos rigorosos de fechamento e constante atualização frente às normas contábeis e processos internos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na classificação, registro, análise, mensuração e conciliação contábil de todo o patrimônio da companhia;
  • Auxiliar na execução de projetos e atividades da área;
  • Trazer propostas de melhoria e inovação para as atividades do dia a dia;
  • Estabelecer relacionamento consistente com as demais áreas da companhia;
  • Auxiliar no processo de auditoria interna e externa;
  • Atuar tempestivamente na aprovação de chamados e contabilizações.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Conhecimento em Contabilidade Básica;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office;
  • Noções de tratamento de dados;
  • Experiência com ERP contábil.

Será um diferencial, caso você possua

  • Formação Completa ou em andamento em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Excel avançado, Power Automate e Looker;
  • Conhecimento em SAP;
  • Experiência no ramo do Varejo.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos: Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

description:
Candidate Experience Operations Analyst (Talent Coordinator)

About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page Careers at Nu - Join our team!.

About the team The Candidate Experience team is responsible for keeping the recruitment engine running with excellence. Our work goes beyond the candidate's experience: we are the connecting point between quality, operational efficiency, automation, and governance for Nu's selection processes.

About the role

You will work in partnership with recruiters, hiring managers, and business stakeholders from various countries to ensure our selection processes flow with quality, structure, and reliable data. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Monitoring ongoing selection processes;
  • Executing and continuously improving operational routines (high-volume scheduling, template reviews, online exercises, pipeline structures, dashboards, etc.);
  • Creating and maintaining initiatives for process optimization and automation (using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, GoodTime, Greenhouse, Slack workflows, etc.);
  • Supporting interviews (structuring interview blocks, committees, participation, and engagement analysis);
  • Diagnosing and resolving operational bottlenecks (e.g., scheduling SLA, % of reschedules, cancellations, template failures).

What we're looking for

  • Advanced or fluent English (must-have);
  • Organization, proactivity, and attention to detail;
  • Ability to scale high-volume operations;
  • Capacity for data analysis and interpretation;
  • Experience with ATS and scheduling tools, Slack, Sheets (or the willingness to learn);
  • Ability to structure routines and implement process improvements;
  • Communication skills with different audiences (tech, business, leadership).

Nice to have

  • Experience with Talent Acquisition or HR/recruitment operations;
  • Intermediate Spanish;
  • Experience with agile methodologies;
  • Enjoy automating things (Zapier, basic scripts, formulas, workflows).

Why Nubank?

  • Purpose-driven work that impacts millions of people.
  • Collaborative and inclusive remote culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Learning and development support to grow your career.
  • Opportunity to help shape the future of financial services.
  • Health, dental and life insurance
  • Transportation assistance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Equity at Nubank
  • Parking partnership - discounted parking in our office
  • Free bike parking with showers available
  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
  • Extended maternity and paternity Leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or twelve weeks of remote work, one will be at the office. Check moreinformation here.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nu, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That's why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring neither of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Guest Operations Stadium Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and delivery of seamless V/VIP guest services and operations within the stadiums for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027, in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich, internal FIFA27 teams, and external stakeholders. The role acts as the primary point of reference for all stadium guest operations, ensuring efficient planning, staff readiness, and high-quality service delivery during match operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of V/VIP services and guest operations across assigned stadiums.
  • Establish, manage, and coordinate stadium-level Guest Operations teams, ensuring clear task allocation in line with the event scope.
  • Support the Guest Operations Senior Manager in the development and implementation of Concepts of Operations, policies, and procedures.
  • Communicate guest management policies, stadium operational plans, and updates to all relevant internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure management of V/ VIP Guests (local & international) is according to agreed operational plans.
  • Ensure agreed service levels are consistently delivered in collaboration with internal departments, service providers, and partners.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Guest Experience Manager on the planning and delivery of V/VIP catering services and lounge experience within the stadium environment.
  • Develop, monitor, and manage key milestones, activity schedules, and workflows, ensuring clear prioritisation and timely delivery.
  • Contribute to budget planning and support the monitoring and review of stadium guest operations expenditures.
  • Plan and deliver stadium-specific V/VIP operations training for Guest Operations Stadium staff, volunteers, hosts, and hostesses.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Event Management, Tourism, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • A Master’s degree in a relevant discipline is considered an asset.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in Guest Operations, Event Services, Protocol, or Hospitality operations within major events, preferably international sports events.
  • Proven experience in stadium or venue-based operations, including V/VIP services and multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Demonstrated project management experience, including planning, coordination, and operational delivery.
  • Experience working with multiple service providers and cross-functional teams in complex operational settings.
  • Experience in budget planning, cost monitoring, and financial tracking is desirable.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong organisational, planning, and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to drive operational excellence and deliver high-quality guest services through structured processes and teamwork.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships at all levels.
  • High level of attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and sound judgement under pressure.
  • Good understanding of organisational processes, governance, and operational policies.
  • Solid financial awareness, including budget management and cost control.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an advantage.
  • Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings, weekends, and event days, as required by the tournament schedule.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural and international environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Manager, Cleaning and Waste Management FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (”FWWC2027” ) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Cleaning and Waste Management Manager, reporting to both FIFA27 Head of Infrastructure & Technical Services and the FIFA Technical Services Senior Manager, will be a key member of the FIFA27 team. This role involves close coordination with key stakeholders to meet operational, environmental, and service quality standards.

The position is responsible for developing, coordinating implementation, and overseeing sustainable cleaning and waste management strategies and operations from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This includes leading upstream and downstream waste management and ensuring a seamless, high-quality tournament experience in line with FIFA’s and regional sustainability standards.

The ideal candidate will combine event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management expertise with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as the primary liaison between FIFA Functional Areas, Local Entities, contractors, and external stakeholders for sustainable cleaning and waste management services.
  • Lead and manage cleaning and waste management team, ensuring efficiency and high performance.
  • Develop and implement the Sustainable Waste management strategy and cleaning operational plan, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s requirements.
  • Develop and manage sustainable cleaning and waste management services budget, ensuring cost control and operational efficiency.
  • Lead the planning, installation, and operations of temporary waste management infrastructure across stadiums, training sites, and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Ensure full integration of cleaning and waste management requirements, maximizing the use of existing venue infrastructure while meeting FIFA standards and event operational needs.
  • Oversee the end-to-end delivery of sustainable cleaning and waste management services, managing resources, partners, suppliers, and contractors to ensure successful execution.
  • Conduct site visits to validate operational readiness, ensuring feasibility, quality, and compliance with operational needs.
  • Oversee the planning and delivery of temporary power, lighting, and other essential technical services for Resource Recovery Centers.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA’s facility management standards.
  • Collaborate with stadium facility management teams, suppliers, and local authorities to guarantee operational readiness by the highest sustainability standards.
  • Provide regular updates to the FIFA Technical Services Senior Manager on key milestones, issues, and recommendations.
  • Coordinate with local authorities the process to secure necessary permits and approvals.
  • Track and report on project progress, identifying risks and mitigation strategies.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and innovation in service planning and delivery.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Resource Management, Economics, Sustainability, Facility Management or a related field.
  • Minimum 10+ years of experience planning and executing sustainable cleaning and waste management services for major sporting events.
  • Proven track record of leading cleaning and waste management service teams in FIFA tournaments or similar global events.
  • Experience in budget management, procurement, and supplier coordination.
  • Strong understanding of stakeholders’ requirements and responsibilities to deliver efficient and sustainable operations.
  • Extensive knowledge of cleaning and waste management delivery, temporary infrastructure, and venue technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Accreditation Client Group Manager
description:
Accreditation Client Group Manager

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Accreditation Client Group Manager plays a key role in the operational delivery of client group accreditation services in support of tournament operations across all venues and official facilities. Reporting to the Accreditation Client Group Senior Manager, the Accreditation Client Group Manager is responsible for the day‑to‑day coordination, and delivery of accreditation services for assigned client groups for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Working within the established tournament accreditation framework, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, FIFA27 Accreditation teams and functional areas, the role ensures that client group accreditation requirements are delivered in line with defined FIFA accreditation policies, access control protocols, and agreed service standards.

The role provides operational leadership to Client Group Coordinators and serves as the primary operational escalation point for assigned client groups.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Client Group Management:
  • Act as the primary accreditation point of contact for assigned client groups (e.g. safety & security, workforce, volunteers, suppliers, commercial partners).
  • Understand and manage client group accreditation requirements, volumes, timelines, and access needs in line with the overall accreditation framework and agreed milestones.
  • Coordinate the delivery of client group accreditation activities across all planning and operational phases.
  • Monitor readiness and proactively identify delivery risks, escalating issues as required.
  • Accreditation Process Delivery:
  • Manage the end‑to‑end accreditation process for assigned client groups, including data collection, validation, access rights assignment, badge production, and distribution.
  • Ensure accurate application of access rights in accordance with approved zoning concepts, access matrices, and security requirements.
  • Coordinate accreditation activities and dependencies with Accreditation Operations, Systems, Security, and Venue teams.
  • Track application progress, volumes, and bottlenecks and implement corrective actions where required.
  • Team Leadership & Support:
  • Lead, coordinate, and support Client Group Coordinators in the delivery of day‑to‑day accreditation activities.
  • Provide guidance on complex cases and ensure consistent application of processes across client groups.
  • Support onboarding, training, and knowledge sharing within the client group team.
  • Promote clear task ownership, prioritisation, and accountability.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:
  • Work closely with FIFA and FIFA27 functional areas to support agreed accreditation requirements and timelines.
  • Communicate accreditation procedures, deadlines, and data requirements clearly and consistently to client groups.
  • Support the preparation and delivery of training sessions, briefings, and guidance materials.
  • Act as the primary operational escalation point for client group accreditation issues, escalating complex or cross‑functional matters to the Client Group Senior Manager.
  • Event‑Time Operations:
  • Support the operation of Accreditation Centres and badge distribution points before and during the tournament.
  • Coordinate with Venue Operations, Security, and Accreditation Operations teams to resolve access‑related issues quickly and effectively.
  • Provide operational decision‑making support within defined authority during peak arrival and match‑day phases.
  • Support on‑site supervision of accreditation staff and workflows as required.
  • Reporting, Compliance & Continuous Improvement:
  • Ensure all client group accreditation activities comply with FIFA accreditation regulations, data protection requirements, and security protocols.
  • Maintain accurate client group accreditation records, statistics, and issue logs.
  • Provide regular operational updates and reports to the Client Group Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post‑event reporting, lessons learned, and knowledge transfer activities.

YOUR PROFILE

  • University degree or equivalent higher education in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in accreditation, access management, client services, or operations within major international events.
  • Strong working knowledge of accreditation systems, access control concepts, and venue zoning models.
  • Experience working in large‑scale, multi‑stakeholder, and multicultural event environments.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in high‑pressure environments.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. The position

The Partnership Development Manager will be responsible for driving sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets. The role requires deep market knowledge and a robust network in the region.

Key responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Senior Partnership Development Manager, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Identify and pursue high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

  • Develop bespoke sponsorship packages that address the unique needs and objectives of prospective partners.
  • Lead negotiations through to successful acquisition, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s commercial guidelines and values.
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Establish and nurture long-term relationships with key sponsor prospects, ensuring continuity and value beyond the tournament.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for the FIFA27 team in Brazil on sales-related matters, supporting or managing the sales process as needed.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Build strong external visibility for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ commercial opportunities, fostering inbound interest and leads through proactive industry engagement.
  • Lead and support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your profile

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.
  • Strong presenter and excellent relationship building skills.
  • Proven experience in sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Strong network and understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Experience in dealing with and negotiating within different cultures.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.

  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Sales CRM tools
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Do que você precisa:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos.

Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação.

A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles.

About Purolabs

Purolabs is an independent, family-run DTC supplements brand based in South London. We've served over 350,000 customers with clean, science-backed supplements. No fillers, no additives, no nonsense. No shareholders to impress. No cutting corners. Just a genuine mission to help people feel better.

The Role

Creative strategy is our biggest growth lever. We're hiring a Creative Strategist to own the full creative system for our paid advertising, from research and ideation through to briefing, production, and performance analysis. You'll develop ad concepts, write scripts and copy, create briefs, and work with editors and creators to produce ads that convert at scale.

This is a performance role. Data guides everything. You'll live inside our ad accounts, study what's working, and use those insights to develop the next round of winning creatives. Creative instinct matters, but the numbers have the final say.

Beyond individual ad creation, you'll build and refine the system itself: creative roadmaps, testing cadence, playbooks, feedback loops, and production workflows. The goal is a repeatable engine, not a series of one-offs.

Your primary focus is Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Experience with TikTok or YouTube advertising is a bonus.

What You'll Do

Research & Insight

  • Mine customer reviews, surveys, forums, and ad comments to understand the language, pain points, and motivations of our audience
  • Monitor competitor ads, offers, angles, and landing pages across the DTC landscape
  • Turn research into clear hypotheses and test plans grounded in consumer psychology

Creative Development

  • Develop ad concepts, hooks, angles, and scripts for video ads, VSLs, and UGC content
  • Write direct-response copy for static ads, carousels, and advertorials
  • Create detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators
  • Own landing page strategy and messaging for paid campaigns, working with the team to build high-converting pages
  • Build and maintain a library of proven hooks, frameworks, and winning ad structures

Performance & Iteration

  • Analyse ad account data to identify winning patterns, fatiguing creatives, and new opportunities
  • Iterate on winning ads at scale, producing variations of hooks, body copy, CTAs, and visual treatments
  • Run a tight feedback loop: learn from data, iterate on what works, kill what doesn't
  • Present weekly creative performance reports with clear recommendations for what to test next

Process & Production

  • Maintain a strong creative cadence: roadmap, launch schedule, timelines, and quality control
  • Manage creative production flow, approvals, and external vendors
  • Build and refine playbooks, workflows, and processes to improve creative output over time
  • Collaborate with our Performance Marketing Manager, designers, video editors, and UGC creators

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in direct-response creative strategy for DTC e-commerce (brand-side, agency, or freelance)
  • Proven track record writing ad scripts, VSL scripts, and static ad copy that delivered measurable results
  • Strong understanding of direct-response copywriting principles (AIDA, PAS, and similar frameworks)
  • Deep knowledge of Meta Ads platform and experience working in high-volume creative testing environments
  • Experience creating detailed creative briefs and managing creative production workflows
  • Strong understanding of consumer psychology, buyer motivation, and what makes people click
  • Ability to analyse ad performance data and translate insights into actionable creative direction
  • Experience using AI tools like Claude and Gemini
  • Excellent written English, clear and persuasive

Nice to Have

  • Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or beauty DTC brands
  • TikTok or YouTube advertising experience
  • Experience casting and managing UGC creators
  • Familiarity with tools like Foreplay, Motion, Triple Whale, or Meta Ad Library
  • Landing page copywriting or CRO experience
  • Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar)
  • Basic design skills (Figma or Canva) for static ad concepts

You'll Thrive Here If You Are

  • Data-obsessed. You make creative decisions based on evidence, not gut feeling. You'd rather test than argue.
  • Commercially minded. You care about ROAS and CPA, not just aesthetics. A beautiful ad that doesn't convert is a failed ad.
  • Fast-moving. You can produce and iterate at pace without sacrificing quality. Speed and volume matter in creative testing.
  • Proactive. You don't wait to be told what to test next. You bring ideas to the table constantly.
  • Detail-oriented. Your briefs are clear. Your scripts are tight. You spot what others miss.
  • A student of the game. You're constantly saving ads, studying hooks, and analysing what's working across DTC.

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)

  • Creative strategy is fully owned and running as a consistent, repeatable system
  • You have deep customer understanding and clear positioning across the funnel
  • You've made measurable impact on ad performance through stronger creative strategy and faster iteration
  • Creative roadmap, playbooks, and production workflows are documented and running smoothly

What We Offer

  • Fully remote, work from anywhere with at least 4 hours daily overlap with UK timezone
  • Competitive rate based on experience
  • Paid time off including UK bank holidays
  • Creative freedom to test bold ideas and own your work from concept to results
  • Direct collaboration with founders, no layers of management
  • A small, dedicated team that values transparency, results, and doing things the right way
  • Products that genuinely help people feel better

How to Apply

Your application must include:

  • A portfolio of ad creative work. Show us ads you've written or developed, with context on the results they drove. This can be a PDF, website, Google Drive link, or Notion page. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.
  • A short Vocaroo recording (2-3 minutes) introducing yourself, what you've worked on, and why this role interests you. Applications without a Vocaroo will not be considered.

This is a remote independent contractor role, not employment. Applications are welcome globally.

Descrição da vaga

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Instalar e manter os sistemas informatizados, identificar e resolver problemas, realizar modificações nas instruções de operação em vigor e adaptar, a fim de prover suporte técnico na sua área de responsabilidade.

  • Prestar atendimento de suporte aos usuários internos e externos, a fim de soluciona-los;
  • Realizar atendimento de chamados através de telefone, sistema de chamados ou e-mail, garantindo o registro de todas as ocorrências;
  • Acompanhar o suporte prestado por empresas terceirizadas e implantações de novas Unidades;
  • Realizar controle para distribuição e compra de periféricos, tais como: mouse, teclado, estabilizador, etc.;
  • Realizar cotação para contratação de serviços relacionados à Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Elaborar especificações técnicas para a compra de itens relacionados à Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Acompanhar disponibilidade de serviços de telefonia, CFTV e ponto eletrônico, bem como acionar os prestadores de serviço sobre a manutenção dos mesmos;
  • Administrar e realizar o controle de usuários do Active Directory;
  • Instalar e solucionar problemas de impressoras em rede, garantindo o bom funcionamento;
  • Detectar defeitos e auxiliar na correção de instalação de softwares, garantindo o bom funcionamento dos aplicativos;
  • Prestar assistência no suporte aos usuários nos aspectos de hardware e software, envolvendo a montagem de computadores, reparos e configurações, a fim de evitar que ocorram problemas;
  • Efetuar instalação de Sistema Operacional (Windows), instalação de impressoras em rede e realizar instalação e configuração de softwares (Pacote Microsoft Office, navegadores, sistemas ERP), a fim de facilitar o processo de trabalho dos usuários;
  • Instalar, treinar e dar suporte a aplicativos desenvolvidos pela empresa e/ou aplicativos de terceiros;
  • Configurar computadores em rede e realizar a manutenção da estrutura física de computadores, garantindo os acessos aos recursos de rede;
  • Apoiar profissionais da equipe de TI nas atividades relacionadas à Tecnologia da Informação, garantindo o bom andamento dos trabalhos;
  • Organizar e receber os equipamentos no estoque de TI testando e selecionando peças para utilização no parque de equipamentos de TI, garantindo que os mesmos atendam os requisitos técnicos;
  • Instalar e configurar Antivírus e Anti-Spyware, a fim de prevenir e remover vírus, trojans e spywares, etc;
  • Administrar servidores de impressão, antivírus e serviços de e-mail corporativo, a fim de garantir o bom funcionamento dos serviços;
  • Efetuar instalação, substituição de hardware, instalação de drivers, corrigir problemas de conflito de hardware e realizar manutenção preventiva em servidores, garantindo o bom funcionamento;
  • Compartilhar recursos de rede em servidores, tais como: pastas, impressoras, computadores, etc, garantindo o acesso e segurança das informações;
  • Configurar internet através de conexão direta via rede ou através de discador, personalização do Internet Explorer, identificação de problemas de navegação;
  • Configurar e-mail através de gerenciador de e-mail Outlook, utilizando servidores POP, SMTP e IMAP, a fim de facilitar a comunicação entre os funcionários da empresa;
  • Instalar e Monitorar o funcionamento de Servidores Windows ou Linux, a fim de manter o bom funcionamento e desempenho dos sistemas;
  • Filtrar e direcionar chamados de suporte técnico;
  • Efetuar abertura de chamado e acompanhar manutenção nos links de internet das operadoras responsáveis;
  • Executar rotinas de backup de dados dos usuários;
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais LGPD;
  • Realizar as atividades das áreas/setores, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

The Senior Specialist is an integral member of the cross-disciplinary well delivery teams and provides support for well planning and execution by developing geologically sound and compliant pore and fracture pressure forecasts and wellbore stability models. They are involved in all aspects of well planning from early concept, through detailed well planning, execution and post well analysis. During implementation the specialist also collaborates with the Real Time Collaboration Operations Center on pressure detection efforts and with subsurface, drilling, and completions to incorporate pore pressure and wellbore stability takeaways and understanding to safely and successfully implement the wells.

Primary Accountabilities

  • Pore Pressure and Fracture Pressure Forecasting: Integrate multiple types of indicators and observations in a geologic context to generate a pre-drill pore pressure and fracture gradient (PPFG) forecast. This may include: pressure from seismic velocities, offset well data such as measured pressures, connection gases, log derived pressures in shale, basin models for building the pore pressure model and log data, drilling events/data, mini-frac/leakoff test data, lost circulation events, impact of reservoir depletion and lithology variations to constrain fracture gradient and minimum stress.
  • Integrate their work with others on the multi-disciplinary well planning team to optimize the pattern on the selection of drilling fluid type/weight, casing string compose, setting depths, potential geo-hazards and mitigation techniques. They communicate the technical work as well as the risks and mitigations to a wide range of partners, ranging from the drilling team, the Operations team supervising the well, leadership as well as co-owners and governmental regulators.
  • Operational Support for Pore Pressure Detection as required for sophisticated development or exploration wells in collaboration with the remote collaboration center; including real-time model calibration, kick analysis, gas and breathing analysis and losses investigations as well as interpretation of formation integrity tests. Also responsible for communicating the updated PPFG model and forecast going forward to the operations team and to recommend potential changes to mudweight or drilling strategy and potential locations for pressure points.
  • Drillability Assessment: Work closely with wells to develop wellbore strengthening model and implementation plan for drilling through depleted reservoirs.
  • Wellbore stability analysis: Develop wellbore stability models as the basis for providing minimum mud weight recommendations for drilling and completing wells. Emphasis on analysis and integration of data from multiple sources e.g. log data, drilling data, cavings analysis, image and caliper log analysis.
  • Operational assessment: Contribute to Reservoir Design and Operating Limits, broaching analyses, zonal isolation assessment, alternate well design, abandonment deviation/risk assessments. Participate in risk assessments to represent the PPFG, zonal isolation and broaching risks.
  • Participation in subsurface related non-productive time (NPT) analyses and investigations.
  • Support development and implementation of a best-in-class PPFG and Geomechanics toolkit.
  • Represent BP externally as required at industry meetings and JIPs etc.
  • Mentor for less experienced team members.

Education

Engineering, Science, Geoscience, Geomechanics or Mathematics.

Crucial Criteria

  • Seasoned and vast experience in relevant oilfield (drilling PPFG/geomechanics) with operator or service company.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to distill complicated technical work to a variety of interested parties.
  • Ability to work with cross-disciplinary teams and go for priorities to deliver ambitious wells.
  • The candidate must be familiar with PPFG, geomechanics, drilling and subsurface aspects of Well Planning and Execution.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Previous PPFG experience with an operator, ideally planning and performing Brazil pre-salt wells; previous geomechanics experience such as wellbore stability and formation pressure integrity tests, strong geology and geophysics background and experience with well planning.
  • Experience generating pre-drill PPFG forecasts for offshore wells in both development and exploration settings.
  • Awareness of Geology, Petrophysics, Basin Modelling, Processing Geophysics, Reservoir Geomechanics, Drilling Engineering, Rig Systems, and Well Control.
  • Software proficiency and coding capability (e.g., VBA, Python, Techlog and Petrel).

Why join us

At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and ambitious environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to encouraging an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.

There are many aspects of our employees’ lives that are meaningful, so we offer benefits ( to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, and excellent retirement benefits, among others!

title: Partner Sales Manager - IHV Alliances
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Partner Sales Manager to be a key contributing team member within the growing IHV alliances organization. Large OEM or Independent Hardware Vendor (IHV) brands - Dell, HPE, IBM, Lenovo, Ericsson, Cisco, Fujitsu and many more - are major partners for Canonical. These companies build software‑defined solutions to capitalize on global open source mandates and associated macro trends. Canonical's flagship product, Ubuntu, and its broader open source portfolio are key ingredients for these partners to realize their aspirations. Canonical represents the best platform for rapid open source innovation.

Reporting to the Head of IHV Alliances, the Partner Sales Manager will work closely with IHV and Canonical teams in various geographies to enable IHV teams, generate and transact opportunities, drive a Canonical agenda within an IHV, and achieve targeted results. They are responsible to build trusted relationships with our partners, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelize the partnership and drive business interactions from across persona - from engineer to CxO. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and participate in executive engagements.

Location

This is a remote role.

The role entails

  • Build strategic relationships and enable partner teams on the partnership
  • Build pipeline and transact opportunities through an IHV
  • Grow partner awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem
  • Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
  • Travel regularly - sometimes internationally - to drive partnerships in person
  • Align and support internal canonical field teams - identify, support, grow, transact
  • Expand existing footprint with IHV customers with an aim to upsell to broader portfolio
  • Support and contribute to broader strategy, initiatives and key campaigns

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
  • Autonomous, disciplined, hands‑on, get‑it‑done mentality
  • Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
  • Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
  • Comfortable in fast‑paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals
  • Experience with Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Team player with superior accountability and customer support skills
  • Credibility and working knowledge of IHVs - their products, go‑to‑market motion, and field
  • Experience managing cross‑functional teams and track record of operational excellence
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
  • Hands on experience with Salesforce and Google Suite a plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado.

Desenvolvemos uma série de projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental.

Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade.

Ser diverso é ser Super!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Objetivo do Cargo:

Atuar como especialista funcional em produtos digitais e aplicativos , garantindo a tradução precisa das necessidades de usuários e negócio em requisitos claros, priorizáveis e implementáveis, suportando todo o ciclo de discovery, delivery e evolução contínua do produto em ambientes ágeis.

Discovery e entendimento do usuário

  • Conduzir discovery orientado a produto , explorando problemas, oportunidades, hipóteses e métricas de sucesso.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com UX/Product na definição de jornadas do usuário, fluxos de navegação e experiências digitais.
  • Levantar e detalhar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais (performance, usabilidade, segurança, disponibilidade).

Estruturação de requisitos para desenvolvimento

  • Traduzir necessidades em épicos, features e histórias de usuário , alinhadas à visão e roadmap do produto.

  • Apoiar a decomposição de demandas visando incrementos pequenos e entregáveis .

  • Atuar como referência funcional para desenvolvedores mobile/web, QA e UX .
  • Apoiar decisões técnicas avaliando impactos em experiência do usuário, dados e integrações.

Integrações e dados

  • Analisar e especificar integrações via APIs , fluxos entre sistemas e consumo/exposição de dados.
  • Garantir consistência entre front-end, back-end e serviços de apoio.
  • Trabalhar com eventos, estados da aplicação e regras de negócio distribuídas.

Qualidade e validação

  • Apoiar testes funcionais e UAT , garantindo aderência da solução ao comportamento esperado do usuário.
  • Validar entregas com base em critérios de aceite, fluxos e métricas definidas no discovery.
  • Contribuir para melhoria contínua do produto com base em feedbacks, métricas e incidentes.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação completa em áreas correlatas.
  • Português fluente.
  • Experiência sólida como Analista de Negócios / Requisitos em produtos digitais ou aplicativos .
  • Vivência prática em squads ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban).
  • Escrita e detalhamento de user stories , critérios de aceite e cenários.
  • Experiência com discovery de produto , entendimento de problema e validação de hipóteses.
  • Conhecimento em UX básico : jornadas, fluxos, wireframes e usabilidade.
  • Capacidade de análise de integrações, APIs e fluxos sistêmicos .
  • Uso de ferramentas de backlog e produto (ex.: Jira ou similares).

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências – Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação – são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Supervisionar as intervenções realizadas pela equipe multidisciplinar;

Atuar como ponto de equilíbrio em divergências técnicas entre profissionais de diferentes áreas para garantir uma abordagem transdisciplinar.

Gerenciar a interação, por meio da participação de reuniões, elaboração de materiais e de relatórios a fim de melhorar a qualidade da adesão e monitoramento;

Liderar reuniões clínicas semanais para discutir casos complexos ou estagnação no desenvolvimento de usuários específicos;

Identificar necessidades de treinamento e organizar momentos de capacitação técnica (ex: cursos em ABA, Denver, comunicação suplementar);

Desenvolver programas de orientação para que as famílias possam dar continuidade às estratégias de manejo comportamental em casa;

Coordenar visitas técnicas ou reuniões com os professores dos usuários para alinhar o Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) escolar com o plano clínico;

Organizar a agenda da equipe, controlando faltas, reposições e otimizando a lista de espera.

  • Ensino Superior completo em Psicologia, Fisioterapia, Fonoaudiólogo, Terapeuta Ocupacional ou áreas correlatas.

title: Creator Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

Darkroom is hiring a Creator Manager to lead client-facing creator strategy and execution across our Creator Services division. This role owns the relationship between brands and our creator network — ensuring campaigns are strategically aligned, operationally sound, and performance‑driven across platforms, including TikTok Shop, Amazon affiliate, LTK, YouTube, and other emerging commerce channels.

As a Creator Manager, you will serve as the primary point of contact for both clients and creators. You will shape activation strategy, oversee execution, and ensure creator output drives measurable impact while maintaining a strong creator experience. If you thrive at the intersection of relationships, strategy, and commerce — this role was built for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Creator Strategy & Client Leadership: Lead creator and influencer strategy across client accounts, serving as the primary client‑facing point of contact — presenting strategy, performance insights, and optimization recommendations.
  • Campaign Execution: Own end‑to‑end execution of creator campaigns, including sourcing, vetting, contracting, onboarding, and performance tracking.
  • Platform Activation: Activate creators across TikTok Shop, affiliate programs, paid UGC, Amazon, LTK, YouTube, and other emerging channels.
  • Commerce & Creative Alignment: Partner with the Account team and Content Studio to align creator efforts to hero SKUs, commission strategy, and creative frameworks.
  • Performance Monitoring: Track campaign performance and proactively recommend optimization opportunities.
  • Network & Operations: Manage usage rights, timelines, deliverables, CRM systems, and Darkroom's creator network infrastructure.
  • Team Development: Mentor junior team members and help scale best practices within Creator Services.

Who You Are

  • 3–6 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, UGC, or affiliate programs.
  • Strong client management experience and comfort leading strategy conversations.
  • Deep understanding of creator workflows, usage rights, and cross‑platform activation.
  • Experience with TikTok Shop and affiliate models preferred; exposure to Amazon affiliate, LTK, or YouTube Shopping is a plus.
  • Analytical and performance‑oriented, with the ability to translate creator output into measurable impact.
  • Highly organized and confident managing multiple clients and creator pipelines simultaneously.
  • Strong communicator with a creator‑first mindset and commercial awareness.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
